```{r}
library(data.table)
```

```{r}
# Read orthology table
mn47_orthologous_genes_table <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/simsearch_athal_31lyr/filtered/MN47_85_90.cnt")
# Get sequences coordinates
mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/simsearch_athal_31lyr/MN47_85_90.table", header=T)
# Select necessary columns
mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates <- mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates %>% dplyr::select(sequence,beg.genome,end.genome,genome.chr)
# Get only 1-1 genes from the table 
mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates_1to1 <- mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates$sequence %in% rownames(mn47_orthologous_genes_table)  
mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates_1to1 <- mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates[mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates_1to1,]
write.csv(mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates_1to1,"/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/orthologous_genes/pannagram_simsearch/coordinates_without_genes.csv" , quote = F, row.names = F)
```

# Get gene names from MN47 annotation
```{r}
#Upload MN47 annotation
library(rtracklayer)
mn47_annotation <- import("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/mn47/8_longest_scaffolds.gtf") 
# Get gene names and coordinates 
mn47_annotation$gene_name <- sub(".*ID:([A-Z0-9]+)\\..*", "\\1", mn47_annotation$note)
```
## Find these genes
```{r}
library(GenomicRanges)
# Find an overlap
genes_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates_1to1$genome.chr,
  ranges = IRanges(start = mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates_1to1$beg.genome, 
                   end = mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates_1to1$end.genome)
)

hits <- findOverlaps(genes_gr, mn47_annotation)

matched_annotation <- mn47_annotation[subjectHits(hits)]
matched_annotation$sequence <- mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates$sequence[queryHits(hits)]
```

```{r}
library(rtracklayer)
library(GenomicRanges)
# Import and extract gene names from CDS rows (where note exists)
mn47_annotation <- import("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/mn47/8_longest_scaffolds.gtf")
# Create GRanges from 1-to-1 orthologous coordinates
mn47_genes <- mn47_annotation[mn47_annotation$type=="gene",]

genes_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates_1to1$genome.chr,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates_1to1$beg.genome,
    end = mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates_1to1$end.genome
  )
)

# Find overlaps
hits <- findOverlaps(genes_gr, mn47_genes)

overlap_width <- width(pintersect(genes_gr[queryHits(hits)], mn47_genes[subjectHits(hits)]))

result <- data.frame(
  thaliana_id = mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates_1to1$sequence[queryHits(hits)],
  lyrata_chr = as.character(seqnames(mn47_genes)[subjectHits(hits)]),
  lyrata_start = mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates_1to1$beg.genome[queryHits(hits)],
  lyrata_end = mn47_orthologous_genes_coordinates_1to1$end.genome[queryHits(hits)],
  lyrata_id = mn47_genes$gene_id[subjectHits(hits)],
  lyrata_start_annotation = start(mn47_genes)[subjectHits(hits)],
  lyrata_end_annotation = end(mn47_genes)[subjectHits(hits)],
  overlap_width = overlap_width
)

# Remove any duplicates
result_clean <- result[order(-result$overlap_width), ]
# Remove any thaliana_id or lyrata_id that appears more than once (both directions)
result_clean <- result_clean[!(duplicated(result_clean$thaliana_id) | duplicated(result_clean$thaliana_id, fromLast = TRUE)), ]
result_clean <- result_clean[!(duplicated(result_clean$lyrata_id)   | duplicated(result_clean$lyrata_id,   fromLast = TRUE)), ]

write.table(result_clean, "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/orthologous_genes/pannagram_simsearch/lyata_mn47_v2_thaliana_tair10_only_unique_thal_lyr.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```
## Simsearch based on the capsella
```{r}
# Read orthology table
capsella_orthologous_genes_table <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/pannagram_thaliana_lyrata_capsella/simsearch/GCA_040086895_85_90.cnt")
# Get sequences coordinates
capsella_orthologous_genes_coordinates <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/pannagram_thaliana_lyrata_capsella/simsearch/GCA_040086895_85_90.table", header=T)
# Select necessary columns
capsella_orthologous_genes_coordinates <- capsella_orthologous_genes_coordinates %>% select(sequence,beg.genome,end.genome,genome.chr)
## Write the output table 
write.table(capsella_orthologous_genes_coordinates, "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/orthologous_genes/pannagram_simsearch/capsella_vs_thaliana_tair10_all_orhtologous_genes.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```
